text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":400,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"$400"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"half the total amount she earned from selling green hats"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"two different colors"},{"id":"q4","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"in two months"},{"id":"q5","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3/4"},{"id":"q6","value":4,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"3/4"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"red sales are half of green sales, so multiply red sales ($400) by 2 to get green sales"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"add red sales and green sales to get the first month total sales"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","q5"],"out":"s3","note":"second month sales are 3/4 of first month total: multiply first month total by the fraction numerator (3)"},{"op":"div","args":["s3","q6"],"out":"s4","note":"divide by the fraction denominator (4) to complete the 3/4 scaling and get second month total"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"add first month total and second month total for the combined two-month total"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"total amount Ariadne made over the two months"},"dismissed":[{"value":2,"reason":"states there are two hat colors, red and green; this count of colors isn't used in the sales calculation"},{"value":2,"reason":"the word 'two' in 'two months' just names how many monthly totals to add; already captured by the final step combining month 1 and month 2, not a separate multiplier"}]}
